capturePolicy: Sanitize DOM before capture; publish flattened metadata-free raster only. No cookies, HAR, console tickets, raw originals, production route IDs or customer data in this manifest.

captureSafety.readOnlyNetworkGuard: After inventory capture, server pages blocked fetch/XHR methods other than GET, HEAD and OPTIONS; window.open was disabled. No console launch button was pressed.
captureSafety.stateObservationLimit: Displayed Running labels and usage are observed UI values only, not an independently verified guest-health claim; blocked POST refreshes can leave an observed value stale.
captureSafety.sanitization: Names, emails, hostnames, server IDs, IPs and relevant attributes were replaced in the DOM before capture. No terminal canvas, node metadata, credential, notification content or raw browser chrome was captured.
captureSafety.metadata: Final WEBP containers retain only their VP8 pixel chunk; EXIF, XMP and ICC chunks are absent.

captures.permission: Authorized read-only production observation; no state-changing controls used.
captures.featureFlagObservation: No feature flags inferred or changed; observed screen only.
